content.value_statement: Supabase projects change quickly, and outdated guidance can create database or auth defects. This skill directs Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to verify docs, use safe workflows, and check Supabase security concerns.
actual_capabilities: Points agents to current Supabase docs before implementation.
Highlights RLS, JWT, service role key, view, and storage security checks.
Guides Supabase CLI discovery, version checks, and fallback options.
Explains MCP server setup, reachability checks, and OAuth troubleshooting.
Recommends migration creation, advisor checks, and local verification steps.
Provides a feedback workflow for reporting skill guidance problems.
limitations: It does not replace review of official Supabase documentation.
It depends on available MCP, CLI, or web access in the agent environment.
It cannot validate credentials, permissions, or production database state by itself.
It is guidance only; agents still need user approval for destructive changes.

use_cases.title: Plan a secure Supabase feature
use_cases.description: Use current docs and security checks before adding auth, storage, database, or realtime behavior.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot MCP and CLI access
use_cases.description: Check Supabase CLI versions, MCP reachability, OAuth setup, and fallback options.

use_cases.title: Review database changes
use_cases.description: Evaluate RLS, views, functions, policies, advisors, and migration readiness before committing schema changes.

prompt_templates.title: Check Supabase Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: I am adding a Supabase feature. Identify the current docs I should verify first, then summarize the safest implementation path.

prompt_templates.title: Debug Auth or Sessions
prompt_templates.prompt: Help debug this Supabase auth issue. Check session handling, JWT freshness, metadata usage, and any RLS policies involved.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Schema Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Supabase schema change. Use an iterative workflow, list verification steps, and explain when to generate the migration.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Security-Sensitive Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these Supabase changes for RLS, views, privileged functions, storage policies, API keys, and migration risks.

output_examples.input: A user asks how to add private project notes.
output_examples.output: The assistant verifies current Supabase docs, recommends RLS for project membership, and lists tests for allowed and denied access.

output_examples.input: A user reports that the MCP server is unavailable.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the official server URL, expects an unauthorized response without a token, then guides OAuth troubleshooting.

output_examples.input: A user needs a database migration.
output_examples.output: The assistant proposes an iterative SQL workflow, runs advisors when available, and creates a reviewed migration after verification.

best_practices: Verify current Supabase docs before implementing feature-specific guidance.
Review RLS, keys, views, storage policies, and JWT claims before changing user data paths.
Use local verification and advisors before committing migrations.
anti_patterns: Treating old model knowledge as authoritative for current Supabase APIs.
Using editable user metadata for authorization decisions.
Creating migration files by guessing filenames or skipping verification.

faq.question: Does this skill run Supabase commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance that agents may use when tools are available and user approval allows command execution.

faq.question: Can it help with RLS policies?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights common RLS mistakes and encourages verification against the actual access model.

faq.question: Does it support Supabase MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes MCP setup guidance, reachability checks, OAuth troubleshooting, and preferred documentation search behavior.

faq.question: Is it only for backend database work?
faq.answer: No. It also covers auth, storage, realtime, Edge Functions, SSR clients, and Supabase documentation workflows.

faq.question: Can it submit feedback to maintainers?
faq.answer: It can guide an agent to draft feedback and ask permission before creating a GitHub issue.

faq.question: Does it replace official Supabase docs?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly directs agents to verify current Supabase documentation before implementation.
